items.question: Under the Ministry of Finance SME incentive packages in UAE government procurement, what extra percentage is added to an SME's final score during evaluation?
items.gold: An additional 10 per cent is added to the final score of SMEs.
items.fact: Ministry of Finance adds 10 percent to SME evaluation scores.

items.question: Under the UAE's Operation 300bn industrial strategy, how many SMEs will Emirates Development Bank help finance?
items.gold: Emirates Development Bank will contribute to financing 13,500 SMEs.
items.fact: Operation 300bn: Emirates Development Bank finances 13,500 SMEs.
